summary: preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload unrelated to package purpose
details: @servicetitan/launchdarkly-service@38.1.7 declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<archive>.zip, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes it (execFileSync) against a shipped 727KB single-line obfuscated bundle math_init.js. The Bun download only occurs when a system bun is not already present, but the execution of math_init.js occurs unconditionally at install time. math_init.js is heavily obfuscated: string-array rotation decoder (WV8StW), hex-named identifiers, char-code lookup routine (hc1jfK9), and a large mixed hex/string constant table (n7gIxM) — the shape of obfuscator.io-style transforms. No readable source for math_init.js is shipped, and its contents have no discernible relation to the package's advertised purpose (a LaunchDarkly feature-flag service wrapper). The combination of an alternate-runtime dropper (using Bun rather than Node to run the payload, which evades Node-based static analysis) with a heavily obfuscated bundle whose behavior is opaque and purpose-mismatched executes arbitrary attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine at npm install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
